neighbours.label: ' again' and other words marking a repeated or further round of the same action
fire: If your mind wanders again, gently bring it back to your breath.
The printer jammed again just before the meeting started.
We tried the old key, and the lock stuck again.
After lunch the baby started crying again in the back seat.
He failed the driving test and had to book it again.
Leave the dough to rise, then knead it again for a minute.
The phone rang again while she was still in the shower.
The river flooded the village again this spring.
quiet: If your mind wanders off, gently bring it back to your breath.
The printer jammed just before the meeting started.
We tried the old key, and the lock stuck at once.
After lunch the baby started crying in the back seat.
He failed the driving test and was upset all week.
Leave the dough to rise, then knead it gently for a minute.
The phone rang while she was still in the shower.
The river flooded the village this spring.
